_comment: Copy this file to config.json to pin where the xArm6 twin lives, for installs that are NOT a sibling of the twin. You usually don't need this: a clone of https://github.com/kouroshSA/xarm6-digital-twin-v5 placed beside A2S2-OS (or under your home dir) is found automatically, whatever the folder is named. Set twin_dir only if auto-discovery can't find it; check the server startup banner ('found via') to see what it resolved. The path points at the xarm_lab_twin folder, may be absolute or relative to the A2S2-OS folder, and ~ is expanded. The env var BENCH_TWIN_DIR overrides this file.
